name: Publish to Hugging Face
description: Export a dataset to the Hugging Face Hub as a dataset repo — the kept images as metadata-free PNG copies, captions matching the dataset kind, a metadata.jsonl and a dataset card — from the dataset's Import & export section. Private by default, consent required, the reference photo off by default. Uses the HF_TOKEN the app already holds for gated downloads and cloud training.
author: lora-dataset-studio

experience.setup_hint: Use a Hugging Face token with permission to write the destination repository.
